# The dialogs drawn through the device (generated by `tools/ui-draw.ts`)

Every `DLG_*.lua` of the archives is opened in one UI world with a device (one Lua state, as in the client), run for one frame of no time (`CKTDGUIDialog::OnFrameMove(0, 0)`: nothing moves, the buttons that wait for their first `ChangeState` make it), drawn once on a cleared 1024 x 768 back buffer through `CKTDGUIDialog::OnFrameRender`, the state manager, the dynamic vertex buffers and `Direct3DDevice9` (WebGPU), and the quads it handed to `DrawPrimitive` are composed again on the CPU by the rules of Direct3D 9 (`packages/ui/test-gpu/reference.ts`). A script that fails is run again after all the others (a sibling script may define the global it needs). The device's picture may differ from the CPU's by 3 levels of a channel (the tolerance of the test). Per dialog: `docs/ui-draw.tsv`.

| | dialogs |
|---|---:|
| DLG scripts | 1,024 |
| the script ran to its end | 992 |
| ... only the second time (it needs a global that a sibling defines) | 9 |
| the script did not run (a game state defines what it needs, FINDINGS 17.1) | 32 |
| drawn without an exception | 1,024 |
| ... whose frame ended in an exception first (what `OnFrameMove` does there is not ported) | 7 |
| ... that draw at least one quad | 894 |
| ... that draw no quad | 130 |
| device and CPU agree (no pixel over 3) | 1,024 |
| the CPU composition has no rule for a quad | 0 |
| ... a pixel is over 3 | 0 |
| draws that are neither of the two shapes the UI makes | 0 (in 0 dialogs) |
| the state stack is not back where it was | 0 |
| quads in all | 16,330 (208 of them bars of edges, 293 without area) |

The largest difference of a channel between the device and the CPU, per dialog: 0: 695, 1: 329.

## What the dialogs ask to draw that is not ported yet

`render.undrawn`, summed over the dialogs: a control class whose `OnFrameRender` is not ported, or a part of one (the strings).

| what | dialogs | times |
|---|---:|---:|
| `CKTDGUIStatic string` | 275 | 1,801 |
| `CKTDGUISlot` | 7 | 158 |
| `CKTDGUIIMEEditBox` | 81 | 125 |
| `CKTDGUIComboBox` | 37 | 70 |
| `CKTDGUIListBox` | 21 | 36 |
| `CKTDGUIEditBox` | 6 | 8 |
| `CMovieData::OnFrameMove` | 3 | 3 |
| `CMovieData::OnFrameRender` | 3 | 3 |
